title: Vogue September 2020: Hope

description.main: The September 2020 issue of American Vogue, themed on hope, with a cover painted by Kerry James Marshall.
description.extended:
The September 2020 issue of American Vogue, given over to the theme of hope, with a cover painted by Kerry James Marshall.

Vogue editors around the world agreed on hope as a common theme for their September issues. The American edition commissioned two painted covers, from Marshall and from Jordan Casteel. The one condition was that the subject wear a gown by one of four designers the magazine chose. The cover lines read Hope, A Special Issue, and 100 voices on the future of fashion.

Marshall's cover shows a fictional Black woman in a white evening gown by Off-White, standing at a glass door that opens onto a pink child's playhouse with a picket fence and a high-rise skyline. She looks out of the frame, not at the viewer. Marshall said he wanted her self-possessed: "I'm here and you can see me, but I'm not here for you." Casteel's cover portrays the designer Aurora James.
